# Security Policy

## Supported versions

The Book of Eternity: Reborn is currently at version 0.5 Pre-Alpha. Only the
current `main` branch is considered for security reports. The game is
unreleased, and general functionality and save compatibility are not
guaranteed before release.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Use GitHub's private
[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/StanislavSmetaninSSM/The-Book-of-Eternity-Reborn/security/advisories/new)
flow. Include reproduction steps, affected files or versions, expected impact,
and any safe supporting material.

Do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub Issues, pull
requests, discussions, or commits. Do not include credentials, tokens, private
data, or exploit details in a public repository surface.

Reports will be reviewed privately. Response times and fixes are not guaranteed
for this unreleased, non-commercial project.
